title: Rabbi Shimon ben Avishalom
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: [Berakhot 7b](https://www.sefaria.org/Berakhot.7b.12-14) mentions him expounding “A psalm of David”: should it not say “A lament of David”? He gives a fitting parable concerning this: once David saw that it was Avshalom, he rejoiced.

He is also mentioned in Megillah 14b (compare [Megillah 14a](https://www.sefaria.org/Megillah.14a.17)), where the name is ben Avshalom; Hyman proposes Avishalom. Hyman also reports this name in Bava Batra 68a according to Dikdukei Soferim.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Megillah 14a has Rabbi Shimon ben Avshalom in the discussion of Deborah’s palm. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3472&lang=en) also cites 14a and uses Avishalom. The apparatus reading for Bava Batra remains Hyman’s report.
